missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Разница' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Небольшая' is the agreeing feminine predicate adjective, and 'совсем' softens it.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Разницу' is the accusative direct object of 'заметил'. 'Сразу' marks immediacy, and 'я' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Разницы' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express none. 'Большой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'между ними' frames the comparison.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Разнице' is in the dative case as the object of the 'придавать значения' construction. 'Он' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of cause. 'Разницей' is in the instrumental case showing what surprises them. 'Такой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'удивлены' is the short-form participle.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location. 'Разница' is the nominative subject of 'есть'. 'Большая' agrees in the feminine, and 'в цене' is the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об этой разнице' uses the prepositional form 'разнице' after 'об' to mean talking about it. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Разницы' is the nominative plural subject of the infinitive phrase. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'трудно заметить' states the difficulty.

missions.phrase: Из-за разницы во времени мы опоздали.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Разницы' is genitive after 'из-за' to give the cause. 'Во времени' is the prepositional modifier, and 'мы' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative in a question. 'Разница' is the nominative subject of the question. 'Какая' agrees in the feminine, and 'между этими словами' gives the instrumental comparison frame.
